defs.def: held or fixed in position firmly; difficult to move or undo 牢固的；紧的；不松动的；难解开的

ex.s: They had to move to Virginia but they were on a very tight ___41___.
ex.t: 他们必须搬到弗吉尼亚，但他们的___41___非常紧张。

ex.s: Tightly holding the permission slip from the orchestra director, I ran all the way home after school, and shakily handed it to my parents with a fear that they might dismiss my desire.
ex.t: 交换学生在以下条件下可以注册ESL课程：__________。

ex.s: on a tight scheduleD. in deep doubt
ex.t: 时间紧迫D. 深深怀疑

defs.def: fitting closely to your body and sometimes uncomfortable 紧身的；紧贴的
very strict and firm 严密的；严格的；严厉的
stretched or pulled so that it cannot stretch much further 拉紧的；绷紧的
with things or people packed closely together, leaving little space between them 装紧的；密集的；挤满的
difficult to manage with because there is not enough 紧的；拮据的；不宽裕的
looking or sounding anxious, upset, angry, etc. 显得紧张的；忐忑不安的；生气的
feeling painful or uncomfortable because of illness or emotion （由于疾病或情感）疼痛的，不适的，憋气的
having a close relationship with sb else or with other people 亲密的；紧密的；密切的
curving suddenly rather than gradually 急转的；陡的
with runners, teams, etc. that seem to be equally good 势均力敌的；不相上下的；旗鼓相当的

ex.s: Good Morning Britain’s Susanna Reid is used to grilling guests on the sofa every morning, but she is cooking up a storm in her latest role — showing families how to prepare delicious and nutritious meals on a tight budget.
ex.t: 英国《早安英国》节目的主持人苏珊娜·里德习惯了每天早上在沙发上盘问嘉宾，但她在最新角色中大展厨艺——向家庭展示如何在预算紧张的情况下准备美味营养的餐食。

defs.def: not wanting to spend much money; not generous 小气的；吝啬的；不大方的

ex.s: I love Robutt and that’s what counts.” And the little robot-mutt, which had never been held so tightly in all its existence, squeaked high and rapid squeaks-happy squeaks.
ex.t: “我爱罗布特，这才是最重要的。”而那只小机器狗——它一生中从未被这样紧紧地抱过——发出又高又急的吱吱声，那是开心的叫声。

ex.s: We could also say Since its creation, the little robot-mutt had never been held so tightly.
ex.t: 我们也可以这样说：自诞生以来，这只小机器狗还从未被这样紧紧地抱过。

ex.s: Eugénie, feeling that she was about to be left alone in the world, came, as it were, nearer to her father, and clasped more tightly this last living link of affection.
ex.t: 欧仁妮觉得自己仿佛即将被孤零零地留在世上，便不由得靠近了父亲，更紧地握住这最后一缕温情的牵绊。

ex.s: Many scientists believe that everything in the universe used to be tightly pressed together.
ex.t: 许多科学家认为，宇宙中的一切都曾经紧密地挤压在一起。

ex.s: Grabbing your fist with your other hand tightly, push up and into his stomach in one motion.
ex.t: 用另一只手紧紧攥住拳头，朝上猛地顶向他的胃部，一气呵成。

defs.def: not allowing the substance mentioned to enter 构成复合词
